title: Read saved originals again
detail: Select up to three eligible saved originals. Your configured service receives these documents for a new reading and may charge again. Prior attempts and charges remain recorded.
session: This selection exists only in this open session. Refreshing or closing loses unstarted selections. No reading starts until you confirm.
stopping: Stopping; finishing active reads. Completed responses are retained. No further documents will start.
uncertain: The outcome is unknown for some selected saved originals. Nothing was retried. Inspect Statements and job activity before explicitly selecting a saved original for another new reading.
finished: New readings finished. Review each result; finished does not mean posted.
running: Reading saved originals again. Completion counts change only when results return.

labels.not_started: Not started; select again to request a new reading

overLimit: Choose at most 1000 documents. Nothing was added.
pickerFailed: Documents could not be selected. Nothing was submitted.

reasons.not_a_regular_file: This is not a regular file
reasons.outcome_unknown: Outcome unknown; inspect saved documents before trying again
reasons.new_reading_available: Available for a new paid reading
reasons.reading_in_progress: A reading is already in progress

requestRefused: OrionViva could not accept this new-reading request. Refresh the selected document details and review job activity before selecting again. Nothing was retried automatically.
selectionTitle: Select saved originals for a new reading
alreadySelected: This saved original is already selected. Use Review selection and reading cost to check the names, remove an original, or confirm a new reading.
selectionFull: Three saved originals are already selected. Review the selection and remove one before selecting another.
sessionBlocked: Selecting a new reading is temporarily unavailable. Wait for active work to finish, or recheck job status and document-reading settings.
confirmationUnavailable: This displayed confirmation is no longer available in this session. Review recent reading activity, then refresh this document’s details before selecting it again. Refreshing does not start a reading.
detailsUnavailable: New reading availability could not be checked. Refresh this document’s details. Refreshing does not start a reading.
